$comment: The exact CI job names that must each conclude success before a revision may be promoted to production or carry a release tag. ONE source of truth: .github/workflows/promote-production.yml and .github/workflows/release.yml both verify against this file through scripts/verify-required-ci-jobs.mjs, and lib/required-ci-jobs.test.ts pins these names to the jobs .github/workflows/ci.yml actually declares, so renaming a job without updating this list fails the suite instead of silently dropping a gate.
jobs: Docker Runtime and Public R2 Smoke
